**Finding: compliant (INSURANCE).**

Section 18 of the Copperleaf agreement satisfies our preferred insurance checklist in full:

- **CGL** — USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§18.1)
- **E&O** — USD 2,000,000 (§18.1)
- **Cyber/privacy** — USD 5,000,000, carried unconditionally rather than only where Customer Data is processed, so it is at least as protective as our position (§18.1)
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law (§18.1), plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as an extra
- **Certificates** — provided on request, with evidence of coverage (§18.2)

Coverage runs throughout the term and one year afterward at Vendor's expense, and §18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline proposed.
